messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- During INC-2026-003, the webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The root cause of INC-2026-009 was two leaders elected during a network partition. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- During INC-2026-009, the job scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03 during incident INC-2025-023. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Follow-up decision from the INC-2026-003 review: the webhook dispatcher will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during incident INC-2025-004. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- As of 2025-08-07, certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead. [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The job scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- Ownership of the job scheduler transferred from the Dune team to the Cinder team on 2025-09-23. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- As of 2025-09-30, the billing API will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-09-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-30]
- Oskar wrote up the feature-flags handover doc for Farah on 2026-02-11. [valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
- Reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023. [decision; valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- From 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 there are no deploys to the ledger service because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11]
- On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2]

Question: On what date did INC-2025-023 happen?

message.reasoning:
The question asks for the date INC-2025-023 happened. Memory says "The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03 during incident INC-2025-023." That gives the date the incident's effects occurred — 2025-10-03. The incident happened on 2025-10-03 (the indexer served stale results starting then).

The answer: 2025-10-03.
